name: GXO Hasbro Flagship Distribution Center - Midway GA

fieldNotes.buildingIdentity: Address geocoded GEOMETRIC_CENTER of Tradeport East Business Center, a multi-building park. The Hasbro/GXO DC (600,000 sq ft, opened March 2026) is identified as the large NE-SW-oriented building closest to the geocoded point; its ~330m x ~165m footprint matches 600,000 sq ft. Street View (2024-12) shows this building with a blue/white striped band, a monument sign, dock doors with trailers, and a fenced truck court. Identity is medium-confidence because several near-identical DC buildings exist in the park.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The truck court is enclosed by continuous perimeter fencing (visible in Street View 2024-12 and z20 satellite). The truck driveway crosses the fence at the SW end — a controlled fenced entry. Gate barrier not crisply resolved.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clear standalone guard booth resolved beside the truck-court entry; small structures present near the dock court could be utility buildings. Treated as remote check-in (kiosk/app) given GXO IQ AI operating system and no visible booth.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock doors with trailers on two distinct building faces (SW/NW interior face and SE face toward the perimeter road) - separate dock banks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ band confident from continuous dock rhythm on two faces; dockDoorCount ~110 is an estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers parked in the SE truck court without tractors; 25-50 stalls estimated.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Liberty County GA, an exurban/rural industrial park surrounded by pine forest and ponds; nearest town Midway is small. Rural.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimated from perimeter box ~401m N-S x ~303m E-W ≈ 38 acres.
